page.overview:
Who is Farmer?

The Farmer is an Alien Conquest minifigure released in May 2011. He is exclusive to the set 7052 UFO Abduction.

The Farmer wears worn-out blue overalls over a white-and-blue checkered shirt. His pants have patches, and several pieces of wheat are caught in his clothes. He has a single-sided headpiece with a beard and a terrified expression, and holds a brown pitchfork.
